failedItems.detail:
›   Error: Nonexistent flags: --delivery-token, --type
 ›   See more help with --help

USAGE
  $ csdx auth:tokens:add [-a <value>] [--delivery] [--management] [-e
    <value>] [-k <value>] [-y] [--token <value>]

FLAGS
  -a, --alias=<value>          Alias (name) you want to assign to the token
  -d, --delivery               Set this flag to save delivery token
  -e, --environment=<value>    Environment name for delivery token
  -k, --stack-api-key=<value>  Stack API Key
  -m, --management             Set this flag to save management token
  -t, --token=<value>          [env: TOKEN] Add the token name
  -y, --yes                    Use this flag to skip confirmation
